Enum Class NamingConvention

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<NamingConvention>
be.imgn.gaia.core.text.NamingConvention
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<NamingConvention>, Constable
public enum NamingConvention extends Enum<NamingConvention>
A naming convention: a way to write a name made of several words, such as timeoutSeconds or timeout-seconds, and the conversion from one to another. 
NamingConvention.LOWER_CAMEL.toLowerHyphen("timeoutSeconds")       // timeout-seconds
NamingConvention.UPPER_UNDERSCORE.toLowerHyphen("TIMEOUT_SECONDS")  // timeout-seconds
NamingConvention.LOWER_HYPHEN.toUpperCamel("http-url")              // HttpUrl
NamingConvention.LOWER_HYPHEN.from("TIMEOUT_SECONDS")               // timeout-seconds

to(NamingConvention, String) converts to a convention chosen at run time.

A conversion splits the text into words, then joins the words in the target convention. Letters change case one code point at a time, with Character.toLowerCase(int), Character.toUpperCase(int) and Character.toTitleCase(int): the result never depends on the default locale.

In camel case, a word starts at an uppercase letter that follows a lowercase letter, a letter without case or a digit, and at the last uppercase letter of a run that a lowercase letter follows. Digits stay in the word they follow. Converted to LOWER_HYPHEN:

  • timeoutSeconds gives timeout-seconds.
  • httpURL gives http-url, and httpURLPath gives http-url-path.
  • ipv4Address gives ipv4-address, utf8 gives utf8, and HTTP2Server gives http2-server.
  • IPv4Address gives i-pv4-address: the P starts a word, since a lowercase letter follows it.

Joined in camel case, a word keeps only its first letter in uppercase, so an acronym does not survive a round trip: http-url gives httpUrl, not httpURL.

The text to convert must follow its convention, or any convention for from(String), or the conversion throws IllegalArgumentException. It must not be empty, must start with a letter, and may contain only letters, digits and the delimiter of its convention, without empty words: no delimiter at the end, and no two delimiters in a row. Its letters must fit the convention:

  • LOWER_CAMEL text must not start with an uppercase or titlecase letter, and UPPER_CAMEL text must start with one.
  • LOWER_HYPHEN, LOWER_UNDERSCORE and LOWER_DOT text must not contain any uppercase or titlecase letter.
  • UPPER_UNDERSCORE text must not contain any lowercase letter.

    • from

      public String from(String text)
      Converts text that follows any convention to this one. Text that several conventions accept, such as name or NAME, is a single word, so the result does not depend on the convention it is read in.
      Parameters:
      text - the text, following any convention
      Returns:
      text following this convention
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if text follows no convention, such as timeout-Seconds or timeout-seconds_max
